message:
fix(storage,auth): integrate streaming snapshots and JWT policy schema 147

Integrate the 49 verified snapshot source mappings and the test-only Identity projection repair. Match the observed OpenBao 2.7.1 JWT role create/update/delete/list ACLs, store configured policies without injecting default, and apply token_no_default_policy at issuance.

Preserve historical role serialization and issued grants, reject root-policy issuance, and require schema 147 for the new policy semantics with publication and restore downgrade checks. Add cold-reopen, policy, ACL, renewal and historical-format regressions.

Source checks and exact before/after diffs are verified. The planned 246 distinct tests and 268 configuration runs still require compilation and execution. This commit does not authorize production cutover or legacy cleanup.
